Modified HAL_PWREx_EnableOverDrive to remove MMIO operations and hardware-dependent while loops that would cause exceptional loop errors in emulation. The function now:
1. Removes all hardware register accesses and configuration macros
2. Removes while loops waiting for hardware flags (PWR_FLAG_ODRDY, PWR_FLAG_ODSWRDY)
3. Returns HAL_OK to allow program to continue execution
4. Maintains the function signature and documentation for compatibility
